text:
Kai: quick design huddle — looking at the request drilldown header and per-span actions. proposal: move export actions out of the cramped top-right toolbar and add a contextual "export" affordance on the right side of each span row (hover + keyboard). also make correlation breadcrumbs copyable. initial thoughts? cc @Lina @Theo
Lina: I like contextual export for targeted debugging. Concern: too many export buttons will clutter dense stacks. Maybe show a three-dot overflow on hover and a single "Download span (.json)" inside. Global toolbar keeps bulk export.
Theo: Accessibility: each span row needs a logical tab stop. Suggest: span row (enter to expand details) -> actions overflow -> export -> formats dialog. For SRs, the overflow should be reachable via keyboard: role=menubutton + aria-expanded.
Maya: Copy/corrid behavior: keep a visible pill, but also allow keyboard binding: when focus is on a span: press "y" to copy corr id. Announce via aria-live: "Correlation ID copied to clipboard" with role=status. Avoid moving focus after copy.
Elliot: Copy microcopy nit: instead of "Correlation ID copied to clipboard" let's use "Copied: correlation id" (shorter for toast). For screen readers, have a slightly longer phrase via aria-live if needed.
Kai: Good point. For visual affordances we can prioritize a single inline overflow icon that consolidates: "Copy corr id", "Download span (.json)", "Export spans (CSV)". Show export size estimate for spans > 1000.
Lina: UX question: should we show file naming preview? e.g., trace-<corrid>-2026-03-22.json. Helps users find downloads. Small CTA under export modal: "Use readable filename" toggle? Might be overkill.
Theo: From an a11y stance, include an accessible filename preview in the dialog with an editable input labeled "Download filename". Ensure keyboard focus lands on first control in the modal and returns to triggering overflow button on close.
Maya: Keyboard shortcut conflict check: "y" for copy might conflict with other apps. Let's add it but behind flag and document in shortcut mapper. Also provide tooltip text on hover with shortcut hint.
Elliot: Telemetry: add events export_initiated(source:span|toolbar|drilldown), export_format, corrid_copy(method:key|button|menu). Also track download success/failure for big exports.
Kai: rollout plan: feature flag + 10% internal -> 10% external -> full. A/B idea: contextual export vs toolbar-only for 2 weeks, measure time-to-first-export and export-per-session.
Lina: Visual: use a subtle left border on focused span row + 2px focus ring on overflow: .span-row:focus{border-left:3px solid var(--focus-strong);} keep dark mode tokens. Also add high-contrast stylesheet for WCAG 2.1 AA.
Theo: aria suggestions: overflow button: aria-haspopup="true" aria-controls="export-menu-<id>" aria-expanded dynamic. For the download input: aria-describedby with file size estimate. Use role=status for copy confirmation to avoid interruptive announcements.
Maya: QA checklist: keyboard-only flow, screen reader walkthrough (NVDA/VoiceOver), mobile pinch/zoom of drilldown, verify focus return after modal close, ensure clipboard works on Safari.
Elliot: We'll need product to sign off on default filename and retention of downloaded snapshots (we're not storing them server-side so file naming is local). Also confirm GDPR note on exported traces in modal copy.
Kai: I'll update Figma with annotated keyboard order and overflow menu states. @Theo please add aria attributes to the component spec. @Elliot can you draft the analytics spec?
deploy-bot: ui-preview/drilldown-export-context-v1 staged (build #2468) :rocket:
Lina: final tiny copy tweak suggestion for menu: "Download span (.json) — includes timestamps and annotations" — keeps users informed.
Kai: love it. I'll push a small PR with the prototype markup and accessibility notes. Please drop any last nits in Figma by EOD.
